spans.s:
पिपतिषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, about to fly or fall,
inclined or addicted to falling repeatedly; (अन्), m.
a bird.

पिपतिषत् पिपतिषत्, पिपतिषा, पिपतिषु.
See under पित्सत्, col. 1.

पिपतिषा, f. wish or inclination to come down
or fall.

पिपतिषु, उस्, उस्, उ, being about to fall; (उस्),
m. a bird.

पिपविषु पिपविषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of
rt. 1. पू), wishing to purify.

पिपाठक पिपाठक, अस्, m., N. of a moun-
tain.

पिपासत् पिपासत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. Desid.
of rt. 1. पा), thirsting, thirsty.

पिपासा, f. thirst, desire to drink.
—पिपासा-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, thirsting, thirsty.

पिपासित, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing to drink, thirsty,
athirst.
पिपासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wishing to drink, thirsty.
पिपासु, उस्, उस्, उ, thirsty, athirst.
पिपिली पिपिली, f. = पिपीलि, an ant.

पिपिष्वत् पिपिष्वत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. a rt.
पि for पी), Ved. (perhaps) swollen, overfull, super-
[]
abundant; (according to Sāy.) favourable to the hus-
bandman.

पिपीतक पिपीतक, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman
who was the first to perform a particular ceremony
in honour of Viṣṇu on the twelfth day of the light
half of the month Vaiśākha; (ई), f. the twelfth day
of the light half of the month Vaiśākha (when giving
away water is an act of merit, so called after the
Brāhman Pipītaka).

पिपील पिपील, अस्, ई, m. f. (perhaps a re-
duplicated form fr. rt. पीड्), an ant.

पिपीलक, अस्, m. a large black ant; (इका), f. the
common small red ant; a female ant.
—पिपीलिका-
परिसर्पण, अम्, n. the running about of ants.

पिपीलिक, अस्, m. an ant; (अम्), n. a kind of gold
supposed to be collected by ants.
—पिपीलिक-
मध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘thin in the middle like an
ant,’ N. of any metre the middle Pāda of which is
shorter than the preceding and following.
—पिपी-
लिक-मध्यमा, f., N. of a species of the Anuṣṭubh
metre.
—पिपीलिका-मध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, a kind of
fasting (beginning on the day of full moon with
fifteen mouthfuls, decreasing by one daily until the
day of new moon, and after that increasing by one
daily until the next day of full moon).

पिपृच्छिषु पिपृच्छिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid.
of rt. प्रछ्), about to ask or inquire, wishing to ask.

पिप्पका पिप्पका, f., Ved. a species of bird;
[cf. पिप्पीक.]
पिप्पटा पिप्पटा, f. a kind of sweetmeat.

पिप्पल पिप्पल, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
3. पा), the holy fig-tree, Ficus Religiosa [cf. अश्वत्-
थ]; a kind of bird; a nipple (so called from its
similarity to a berry); the sleeve of a jacket or coat;
N. of a son of Mitra and Revatī; (आस्), m. pl., N.
of a school of the Atharva-veda; (आस्), f., N. of a
river; (ई), f. a berry; long pepper, Piper Longum
(both plant and berry; cf. कपि-प्˚, जल-प्˚, तोय-प्˚);
(अम्), n. a berry in general, the berry of the tree
Ficus Religiosa; sensual enjoyment; water; the
sleeve of a coat; [cf. Gr. πίπερι, πέπερι; Lat.
piper.]
—पिप्पलाद (˚ल-अद˚), अस्, m. ‘eater
of berries,’ N. of an ancient teacher of the
Atharva-veda; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a school of the
Atharva-veda (also पिप्पलादकास्).
—पिप्पलाद-
तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a sacred bathing-place.
—पिप्-
पलाद-श्रुति, इस्, f., N. of a work mentioned in
the Parāśara-smṛti.
—पिप्पला-वती, f., N. of a
river.
—पिप्पली-मूल, अम्, n. the root of long
pepper.
—पिप्पली-लवण, ए, n. du. pepper and salt.
पिप्पलक, अम्, n. a nipple; sewing thread.
पिप्पलायन, अस्, m., N. of a man.

पिप्पलि, इस्, f. long pepper; वसिष्ठस्य पिप्पलि,
N. of a Sāman.
—पिप्पलि-श्रोणि, इस्, f., N. of a river.
पिप्पलीका, f. a species of plant (= अश्वत्थी).

पिप्पलू पिप्पलू, ऊस्, m. or f. (?), N. of a
man (or woman ?).

पिप्पिका पिप्पिका, f. the tartar of the teeth;
[cf. पिट्टक.]

पिप्पीक पिप्पीक, अस्, m., Ved. a species of
animal, probably a bird; [cf. पिप्पका.]

पिप्रीषा पिप्रीषा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. 1.
प्री), Ved. desire of pleasing or showing kindness.

पिप्रीषु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of pleasing, wishing
to give pleasure.

पिप्रु पिप्रु, उस्, m. (fr. rt. पॄ?), Ved., N.
of a demon (who was conquered and whose strong-
holds were destroyed by Indra).

पिप्लु पिप्लु, उस्, m. (perhaps for अपि-प्लु;
said to be fr. rt. प्लुष् with अपि), a freckle, mark,
mole.
—पिप्लु-कर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, having a mark on
the ear.
—पिप्लु-प्रच्छादन, अस्, ई, अम्, covering
or concealing a mole.

पीपिवस्, आन्, पिप्युषी, अत्, Ved. swelling, swollen,
distended, overflowing, dropping (Sāy. = प्र-वृद्-
ध, पीन, वर्धयत्, आ-प्यायितृ).

पीप्याना, f., Ved. having a full or swelling breast
(Sāy. = पुत्रं स्तनम् पाययन्ती).

पीपरि पीपरि, इस्, m. a species of Plaksha
of low growth.
